messages.content: 在撲克牌遊戲中，誰擁有最多的紙牌？

function.name: play_poker

cards_per_player.description: The number of cards to be dealt to each player.

game_type.description: Type of the poker game. Defaults to 'Texas Holdem'

message.content: 在標準的撲克遊戲（例如德州撲克）裡，每位玩家都會被發到相同數量的手牌（通常是兩張）。因此，沒有任何一個玩家會比其他人持有更多的私人紙牌。若你指的是公共牌（如翻牌、轉牌、河牌），那麼這些牌由莊家（Dealer）發出並放置於桌面上，而不是「擁有」在某個玩家手中。簡而言之，在正常發牌流程下，所有玩家手中的紙牌數量是一致的。
message.reasoning:
The user asks: "在撲克牌遊戲中，誰擁有最多的紙牌？" which translates to "In a card game, who has the most cards?" They want to know who holds the most cards? But context: In poker, each player gets two cards (in Texas Hold'em). But maybe they refer to dealing? The question might be ambiguous. We need to interpret: In a poker game, who has the most cards? Usually all players have equal number of cards. But if we consider community cards, the dealer deals them. But the question likely expects answer: All players have same number of cards; no one has more than others. Or maybe the dealer deals the cards but doesn't hold them. So answer: Each player receives same number of cards; no one has more.
